witnesses.separates: two bars of 5 that meet at a corner cell, so one 4-connected part is an L: the concept is undefined on it; $Runs turns each of the two rows-and-columns runs about its own middle into another L; $ObjectD4 is undefined on it, since the L redrawn under D4_CW, D4_CC, D4_DG and D4_AD gives different outputs
a bar of 2 and a bar of 8 apart from each other: the concept, with one mark color, is undefined; $PartColors turns each bar in its own color
a field of 0, not the stored background 7, with a bar of 5: the concept takes every non-7 cell as marked and is undefined; background=DominantColor takes 0 and turns the bar
a bar of 5 along the whole top row, whose turn reaches two rows above the frame: the concept draws the part inside the frame; $UndefinedPastFrame is undefined
